item.title: bit_count
item.description: Return the number of ones in the binary representation of the absolute value of the integer. This function does not generate a change. Function int.bit_count() Arguments None Return value Return the number of ones in the binary representation of the absolute value of the integer. Example This code creates a room, gives the room a name and uses the name() function to return the name. (42).bit_count(); // Returns 3, binary representation: 0b101010 Return value in JSON format

item.title: of_type
item.description: Returns the stored ThingsDB instance of a specific type matching the given ID. The stored thing must already be of the specified type. For example, if #3 is an instance of type F, (3).of_type('T') will fail. This function validates the type rather than converting it. When the type name is known at write-time, the constructor syntax is preferred: // Shorthand syntax for a static type T(123); // Equivalent using of_type (123).
